name: Methyl acetoacetate
description: Methyl acetoacetate ( CAS 105-45-3 ), commonly abbreviated as MAA, is a beta-ketoester used across coatings, polymer chemistry, and flavor manufacturing. Acetoacetic acid methyl ester is a recognized alternative name buyers encounter in technical sourcing contexts. It functions as a reactive intermediate and solvent carrier in industrial formulation. In coatings and printing inks, MAA acts as a crosslinking agent in acetoacetate-functional systems, enabling ambient-cure reactions without isocyanates. Polymer manufacturers use it as a monomer building block to introduce reactive ester functionality into acrylic and vinyl resins. In flavor formulation, it contributes fruity, rum-like top notes to food products and is used in compounding flavor concentrates. This chemical is essential for confectionery and beverages. Personal care formulators incorporate it as a fragrance intermediate in the synthesis of aroma chemicals used in finished cosmetic products and various consumer goods. Methyl acetoacetate is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities, with bulk tanker options available for high-volume industrial buyers. It is offered in technical grade for coatings and polymer applications. The product is also available in purity grades meeting food and flavor industry specifications.
